from: chapitre 5 de la vidéo longue (batteries pour le réseau)
paragraphs: The fastest-growing part of Tesla isn't a car.
Tesla builds huge battery systems, each one about the size of a shipping container, that power companies use to store electricity and release it when demand peaks.
In 2020, Tesla installed about {three gigawatt-hours|3 gigawatt-hours} of storage. In 2025, almost {forty-seven.|47.} That's {fifteen times|15 times} more in five years.
Revenue followed: from {two billion dollars|$2 billion} in 2020 to almost {thirteen billion|$13 billion} in 2025.

And this business is more profitable than the cars. In 2025, Tesla kept close to {thirty cents|30 cents} of gross profit on each dollar of energy sales, compared with roughly {eighteen|18} for the company as a whole.
It's not the part of Tesla that makes headlines. Full story on the channel.
